_comment: Tier-2 for dune::stokes#1 and dune::navier_stokes#5. Taylor-Hood (P2 velocity, P1 pressure) Poiseuille flow on an 8x8 grid, 659 dofs, linear.tolerance 1e-12; wall time 269 s on 2026-08-06 (dune-fem 2.12.0.2), dominated by the composite-space builds. Measured: solver=('suitesparse','umfpack') reports linear_iterations 1; cg converges in 651, gmres in 25123, bicgstab in 9297 — ALL THREE CONVERGE, which is the retraction the catalog already carries, and their solutions sit 2.068e-12, 3.188e-10 and 9.375e-11 relative to the direct one. So the signal is cost and accuracy, not failure. The default preconditioner is 'none': passing it explicitly reproduced the default gmres count EXACTLY (25123 both ways), while 'ssor' cut it to 2027 and 'jacobi' to 8102. ASSERTION POLICY: iteration counts are asserted by ORDER OF MAGNITUDE only (direct == 1, worst Krylov > 1000x that). The catalog itself records that an earlier revision's six digits did not reproduce, and these numbers are grid- and tolerance-dependent — do not pin them. MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 runs the three Krylov labels with the direct UMFPACK solver, so every iteration count collapses to the direct solver's. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectations 'krylov_costs_orders_of_magnitude_more=True', 'default_preconditioner_is_none=True', 'a_preconditioner_reduces_the_count=True', 'dune_saddle_point_solver_cost_verified=True' are no longer printed and the forbidden token 'FAIL:' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness). ENVIRONMENT: there is no ofa-dune conda env on this host, which is the interpreter scripts/run_tier2_fixtures.py falls back to; dune-fem 2.12.0.2 lives in ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env. Without DUNE_PYTHON set to that interpreter the runner records this fixture as `skipped`, not `failed`, so a summary that counts only passes and failures shows nothing wrong while nothing was executed. Every measurement quoted above, and the mutation verdict, was taken with DUNE_PYTHON=~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python.
